notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 - Spectator Beta
notes.content:
Hello, drivers!

Today we are releasing a Beta version of our new Spectator feature for Karting Superstars. In this current state, the feature is playable, however, there are still UX & UI improvements we need to do, which will be our next area of focus. 

Thank you for your patience with our team as we're slowly able to keep building this beloved game! 

Update 1.0.7 Changelist :
[list]
[*] Added a TV camera to Centrifuge (Club)
[*] Pause on controller disconnect
[*] Increased respawn speed in TT
[*] New custom lobby UX (Beta)
[*] Spectator mode (Beta)
[*] New track select UX (edited) 
[/list]

What we're focusing on: 
[list]
[*] New art pipeline to make tracks much faster
[*] Netcode: Improved rigid-body synchronisation
[*] New tracks & replay camera refinements to existing tracks
[/list]

If you have questions, comments or reports, please use our [url=https://discord.gg/circuitsuperstars]Discord [/url] to communicate them. 

Thank you for playing! 

Love, 
OFG Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello, drivers! 

We have a quick patch today with the following changes to Karting Superstars

- Numerous improvements to German localization - Thank you to the wonderful community member known as Dremet (creator of CSUP.APP) for helping us with these.
- The duration of "Waiting for connections" in online multiplayer has been increased to 60 seconds to give players enough time to get into the match.
- Pausing during a screen fade in a race will no longer cause the fade to get stuck.
- Fixed numerous small instabilities.

Love, 

OFG Team

notes.title: EA Update 1.0.5: Netcode improvements, online collisions and Aero-duck system.
notes.content:
Hello, drivers!

We’ve released Patch 1.0.5 for Karting Superstars! For this patch, John has put a lot of effort behind improving the general online experience of Karting Superstars. A lot of you will be excited to hear we have added collisions to online play; we’re looking forward to hearing what you think! On the gameplay side, Alberto worked on creating the Aeroduck 🦆 system, previously referred to as Human DRS. This system was inspired by Alberto's and Carlos' karting experience, we all believed this was a great addition to the strategic depth of KSUP. 

Here’s what is new on the patch:

🟣New Aeroduck 🦆 gameplay system
Your driver can now duck to draft. This resource can be used strategically to gain marginal advantages or pass other drivers at the right opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545660/ed984717db2c53cf228bad413f4ffc8f3018994b.gif[/img]

🟣 Improved online driving experience.
🟣Collisions are now permitted in online races.
🟣Reduced load times in general, and in particular when two consecutive races happen on the same track.
🟣Removed vehicle select. You now automatically use the livery you last selected in the garage.
🟣Online races now have a driver showcase as you wait for players to join the race! This is a nice spot to show off your unlocked idles.
🟣6 non-customizable funky Kart liveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545660/adbbf44d796f54a390273a854d321ec6327a76d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545660/e953cb0842479947909ed7f1203209b9ea223cb3.png[/img]

🟣 Key bindings will correctly reflect non-US keyboard layouts.

As Karting Superstars is on Early Access, it’s important to note that a lot of these changes are experimental and we are very much looking for your feedback. Let us know about your experience with these new systems over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/circuitsuperstars]Discord[/url].

We hope you enjoy this update!

Love,

OFG Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.4: New Track - Cherry Drive!
notes.content:
Hello, drivers!

Today we are introducing a track inspired by the beautiful springs in Vancouver, during which the city gets covered in pink-crested Cherry Blossom trees! 

We have been working on new gameplay features, more tracks and our Netcode 2.0. Stay tuned for more updates throughout November. 

We hope you enjoy this new racing space!

Love, 
OFG Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 (October 3, 2023)
notes.content:
[h1]Release Notes: Karting Superstars EA v1.0.3 (October 3, 2023)[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]The mouse can now be used to control the camera in the main menu.
[/list]
[h2]Track Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hidden Lake & Centrifuge: Floating Grid, Start/Finish Lines, and Tire Barriers corrected.
[*]Sugar Hill: Start line placement corrected.
[*]Sugar Hill: Crowd sound effects are no longer present where there are no crowds.
[*]Copperwood: Full Reverse exploit eliminated.
[/list]
[h2]General Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unknown input devices are no longer incorrectly mapped to UI actions by default, which was previously preventing interaction with the UI in some cases.
[*] Visible seams on Tony Kanaan’s helmet have been removed.
[*] Pausing and resuming a race intro is less likely to trigger a rare black/darkened overlay during a race.
[*] A very tiny Driver & Kart is no longer visible behind the vehicle in the vehicle select screen.
[*] The “Good Sport” achievement (complete a race with no penalties) is no longer granted in error when the player did incur penalties.
[*] Penalties are now recorded properly the replay headers of online races for use by third-party applications.
[*] Time Trials now make more cross-reference checks to ensure that a better lap time is not overwritten with a worse one.
[*] Celebration animations in Kartcade and Customizations areas now hold a ghosted trophy.
[*] Player color bands in the UI now show color #4.
[*] Replays from Online now show the correct name in the replays list, instead of being labeled “Kartcade”.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Spawn points are now closer to the start line on some tracks.
[*]The countdown times on Copperwood reverse routes are no longer extremely short.
[*]Modded AI drivers now correctly load their kart livery colors and numbers.
[*]AI driver behaviour has been tuned on all tracks.
[*]Drafting has been enabled in Kartcade.
[*]Post-race cameras have been added to Hidden Lake.
[*]Grass on Hidden Lake now has the correct grip values.
[*]The "unknown" column has been removed from the Time Trial pause menu leaderboard.
[*]Ghosts in time trials now fade out when near the player.
[*]Ghost visuals once again work when ghosting occurs due to lapping with "Prevent Lapping Collisions" enabled.
[*]Qualifier duration and mode settings now become unavailable in Kartcore and Custom Lobbies when qualifiers are disabled.
[*]Helmet stickers are now neutrally colored.
[/list]

notes.title: Design Journal: What is novel on Karting Superstars?
notes.content:
Hello, drivers!

Hope you are all having a great weekend and are hopefully enjoying the demo of Karting Superstars! We are so excited to share that the game will release on [b]Early Access this September 13th[/b]. We are very excited to work with this community during Early Access to make Karting Superstars the absolute best it can be. 

For those interested in our design intentions and vision, we wanted to share some of the detailed novelties found on Karting Superstars. Here are a few of the biggest aspects we’ve focused on so far:

- A new perspective: Karting Superstars is a third person camera game. We’ve retained the fantastic pacing, close competition and close connection to the vehicles that we created in Circuit Superstars, but now with a much closer view of the action and increased sense of speed. This paired up with karting makes for a completely new experience that we’re very excited to bring to the hands of racers. This new perspective also means we’ve adjusted the physics significantly, and expanded the racetracks to complete painting the picture of where they are located, and changed up the way our audio works.

- A new art direction, with beautifully crafted karts and drivers to take your customized looks to new heights.

- Improved rendering: We’re pushing the artistic vision we’ve had for the world of motorsport to create more beautiful and present worlds you love to be on.

- Animated drivers: of course, karting needs more than floating heads, so we’ve focused on making a fantastic looking system for the drivers to animate with the kart, and we can’t wait to expand on it with new mechanics that take advantage of this new feature, such as ‘Human DRS’ which we haven’t yet added to the game.

- Expanded liveries: with drivers on top of the karts, this also means that your livery is now composed of the kart + your race suit! We hope you enjoy making beautiful combinations that take advantage of the new possibilities, and now all karts, race suits and helmets support up to four colours.

- AI: we’re improving the way the AI races, making them more aware of other drivers as well as the track limits. These two make up for a much more fair and exciting racing experience. We’re going to have for the first time in our games the possibility to customize the driver difficulty directly, from a range of 0 all the way up to 120. We don’t think humans can beat past 105, but feel free to try!

- Adaptive AI: Also known as rubberbanding, we’ve added it, but we want you to choose how much you want it! We think it can enhance the racing experience for many novice and experts alike, so we hope you try it out and find what you prefer on your own.

- Custom AI drivers: A way to mod the drivers and create your own fantasy races. This is done via modifying a file included with the game, which means you can share those files or obtain them from other players. We can’t wait to see what you create with this since it is the first time we add a modding possibility to our games.

- Kartcade: A new single player format that includes challenges during races for an added layer of excitement. Challenges get refilled once you complete each one, so you can try and complete as many on each race as you can. Once the race finishes, your race result, challenges and difficulty get compounded to estimate your Karcade score, which helps you unlock new customization items.

- Free camera in replays: We know many players love to take pictures in the games they play, so we’ve worked on making sure you have ways to capture the action in the way you envision. We still can improve this since it doesn’t have photographic control for field of view or depth of field but we’re happy that we’ve taken this first step to making it a possibility.

- Rolling starts: Direct engine Go-Karts need rolling starts in order to portray them properly, and the excitement and tension felt in the moments before a race is something we’re very excited to have players experience!

Our [url=https://discord.com/invite/circuitsuperstars]Discord[/url] is a great place to share your thoughts. Join us there for more discussion. 

Thank you for reading!

Love,
OFG Team
